reviews.title: Lots wrong here.
reviews.text:
First and foremost, this game can be fun and quite addicting with the fast rounds and tons of characters. That being said this game is not very good at all. The AI bot teammates can be very inconsistent. The abilities feel very monotonous. It claims to have anticheat but too many time I get 1 shot killed by enemy’s using same cards I have that have zero one shot killed ability which I do not understand. 

But the real problem is. This game is just a money grab. Box wait times are long for very little reward, the $20 a month VIP plan gives you minimal value and then there are multiple other $20 a month plans to unlock different reward packages. Just feels like a very scammy game that is just after your money. Wheel spins are the worst always give you 2 ad spins but give you the bottom tier wheel slots every single time without fail. Then they want you to pay 3-20 USD for additional spins. By far the most pay to play/scammy game I’ve tried reviewed this year.
